title: Fefferman-Szegő kernels and finite-type rigidity on egg domains
summary: We compute the Fefferman boundary measure and the associated Fefferman--Szegő kernel for the egg domains $$ E_{n,m}=\{(z,w)\in\mathbb{C}^{n-1}\times\mathbb{C}:\ |z|^2+|w|^{2m}<1\}. $$ The kernel is given both by an orthogonal monomial expansion and by a closed form in a natural auxiliary finite-type variable; its diagonal weak-boundary exponent recovers the integer $m$.
